zh: 金管局指上季中小企信貸狀況略見改善
83%受訪企業指貸款批核取態持平或較易
獲批貸款企業中僅2%表示銀行取態收緊
work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority reported a slight improvement in SME credit conditions during the third quarter. Excluding neutral responses, 83% of surveyed SMEs felt bank lending attitudes remained unchanged or became easier compared to six months prior. Furthermore, only 2% of firms with approved facilities reported tighter lending conditions from banks.

zh: 外匯基金第三季投資收入錄得186億元
投資收入按年跌近七成但維持正回報
官方外匯儲備資產10月底增至4405億美元
work.en: The HKMA Exchange Fund posted an investment income of HK$18.6 billion for the third quarter, declining nearly 70% year-on-year. Separately, official foreign currency reserve assets rose by US$7.6 billion month-on-month to US$440.5 billion at the end of October.

zh: 金管局阮國恒強調銀行體系保持穩定
業界撥備覆蓋率高且整體信貸風險可控
港銀目前整體盈利能力依然維持良好
work.en: HKMA Deputy Chief Executive Arthur Yuen expressed confidence in the stability of the banking sector, noting that credit risks remain manageable. He highlighted that Hong Kong banks possess high provision coverage ratios and maintain sound profitability.

zh: 金管局公布第3季「中小企貸款狀況調查」結果顯示，
中小企信貸狀況略有改善。
調查顯示，撇除回答「沒意見/不知道」的受訪中小企，
work.en: 金管局公布第3季「中小企貸款狀況調查」結果顯示，中小企信貸狀況略有改善。 調查顯示，撇除回答「沒意見/不知道」的受訪中小企，83%認為銀行在上季貸款批核的取態與6個月前相比「沒有分別」或「較容易」，按季上升5個百分點；17%認為銀行取態「較困難」，下跌5個百分點。金管局說，貸款觀感較困難，並不一定反映企業在借貸上遇到實質困難，而是可以受多項因素影響，例如媒體及新聞報道、生意經營狀況及親友意見。 在獲批貸款企業當中，2%表示銀行對貸款的取態「收緊」，比例較前一季下降一半。貸款收緊的含義包括降低備用信貸額和貸款額、信貸利率上升、增加抵押品要求或縮短貸款年期等。獲批貸款的中小企佔受訪企業總數18%。 另外，有2%受訪者曾於上季向銀行申請新貸款。在已知申請結果的受訪者中，表示申請完全成功或部分成功的佔78%，按季下跌7個百分點。 金管局提醒，由於獲批貸款及申請新貸款的中小企比例較小，調查結果容易出現較大波動，詮釋時需要注意。 編輯：宋家樑

zh: 反映本港二手樓價走勢的中原城市領先指數（CCL）最新報159.11點
，按周跌0.17%，連跌4星期，是超過2年以來首次出現4周連跌，
創近5個月低位。
work.en: 反映本港二手樓價走勢的中原城市領先指數（CCL）最新報159.11點，按周跌0.17%，連跌4星期，是超過2年以來首次出現4周連跌，創近5個月低位。 大型屋苑及中小型單位樓價分別跌逾0.1%及近0.2%，大型單位變動不大。 各區樓價表現分化，港島樓價按周跌逾2.5%，過去4星期累計跌近5%，創近7個月低位；新界東樓價升逾1.6%，創逾2個月高位；九龍及新界西分別微升約0.1%和0.6%。 CCL今年以來累計升10.41%，當中，港島及新界東樓價累升近12%。 中原地產表示，新盤持續低價促銷搶客，加上預期年內息口可能上調，以及金融市場波動，二手市場仍然受壓。 編輯：宋家樑

smalltalk_hk.headline: HKEX Q3 Net Profit Dips 0.8% Amid Ongoing Market Volatility
smalltalk_hk.body: HKEX recorded a 0.8% drop in third-quarter profit, though CEO Bonnie Chan noted the underlying performance still demonstrates persistent growth momentum. Citi maintained a Buy rating on the bourse operator with a target price of HK$460 despite the results coming in below consensus.

smalltalk_hk.headline: CCL Secondary Home Price Index Drops to Near Five-Month Low
smalltalk_hk.body: The Centa-City Leading Index fell 0.17% week-on-week to 159.11, marking four consecutive weeks of declines for the first time in over two years. The drop was led by Hong Kong Island homes falling over 2.5% in a week, pressured by low-priced new property launches.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Fintech Chocolate Finance Debuts Cash Management Offering in Hong Kong
smalltalk_hk.body: Singapore-headquartered fintech Chocolate Finance has launched in Hong Kong, offering guaranteed returns of 3.8% on the first HK$100,000 and 3.5% on the subsequent HK$200,000. The platform targets retail deposits via its Chocolate Advantage Programme.

smalltalk_hk.headline: HashKey Exchange Lists SBI's Tokenised Japanese Equity Fund
smalltalk_hk.body: SBI Global Asset Management has made its tokenised Japanese equity fund, JX, available on Hong Kong's licensed crypto platform HashKey Exchange via its HashKey Earn service. This expands distribution beyond its previous exclusive availability through Singapore-based ADDX.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Yuanxin Energy Surges 120% Above IPO Price in Grey-Market Trading
smalltalk_hk.body: Shares of Yuanxin Energy jumped 120% to close around HK$21.52 in pre-listing grey-market trading ahead of its Hong Kong main board debut. The energy storage company had opened up 76.4% at HK$17.25.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Johnson Cleaning and Grand Power Issue Interims Profit Warnings
smalltalk_hk.body: Both Johnson Cleaning (01955) and Grand Power (08121) announced that they expect their interim results to swing from profit into a net loss.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Elion International Shares Jump Over 12% After Visual Effects Acquisition
smalltalk_hk.body: Elion International acquired a visual effects company involved in major productions including The Battle at Lake Changjin and Three-Body for HK$170 million. Its shares surged by more than 12% following the announcement.

juicy_hk.headline: 海關檢獲5隻受管制屬瀕危物種活龜 估計市值約5萬元
juicy_hk.body: 海關在機場檢獲5隻懷疑受管制屬瀕危物種的活龜，估計市值共約5萬元。 關員今日檢查一個由美國進口至香港，報稱載有玩具模型禮盒的包裹。

juicy_hk.headline: 青年發展高峰論壇沈靖韜籲裝備自己 曾比特稱保持初心找想做的事
juicy_hk.body: 民政及青年事務局主辦的青年發展高峰論壇，下午舉行三場專題論壇，匯聚來自創意產業、文化藝術、傑出學者， 以及創科和商界的領袖等，與青年分享經驗及最新發展。

juicy_hk.headline: 周一鳴：將禁毒教育融入年輕人日常生活 提升對毒害警覺性
juicy_hk.body: 警務處處長周一鳴表示，近年毒品依托咪酯對青少年禍害日益嚴重，警方思考如何把禁毒教育融入年輕人的日常生活， 致力透過青少年喜歡的活動形式，提升他們對毒害的警覺性及認知。

juicy_hk.headline: 3人涉手工啤酒機投資騙案被捕 6市民疑受騙共投資逾400萬元
juicy_hk.body: 警方偵破一宗涉及手工啤酒機的投資騙案，拘捕3人。 被捕的兩男一女，涉嫌串謀詐騙，年齡由46至54歲，報稱是公司董事、辦事處負責人及負責招募投資者。

juicy_hk.headline: 醫療器械規管擬按風險分級 矯視隱形眼鏡及小便試紙等須註冊
juicy_hk.body: 醫務衞生局向立法會提交文件，表示會爭取在明年提交《醫療器械條例草案》，取代現行自願參與的行政管理制度， 當局將採取雙軌並行的規管模式，涵蓋醫療器械在推出市場前，及推出市場後的風險管理環節，包括透過註冊制度及貿易商牌照制度，

juicy_hk.headline: 青年發展高峰論壇逾3300人登記參加 麥美娟稱反應熱烈
juicy_hk.body: 民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟表示，今屆香港青年發展高峰論壇反應熱烈，超過3300人登記參加，人數較往年增加。 除了本地青年，有超過700名來自內地不同城市及35個國家與地區的年輕人參與交流。

juicy_sg.headline: Man Catfished Dating App Targets into Rigged Mahjong Games, Jailed 2 Years
juicy_sg.body: A 27-year-old Singaporean man created fake female profiles on Tinder and OkCupid to lure male dates into fixed mahjong matches. He was handed a two-year prison sentence and slapped with a S$15,000 fine for the deception.

juicy_sg.headline: Singapore Court Orders Seizure of Tata Power Subsidiary Shares Over $650M Dispute
juicy_sg.body: The Singapore High Court approved the seizure and sale of Tata Power's equity in two subsidiaries to enforce an international arbitration award worth approximately S$850 million (US$650 million). The enforcement concludes a massive multi-jurisdictional recovery suit.

juicy_sg.headline: Court of Appeal Details Grounds for Acquitting Wah!Banana Actor Lev Panfilov
juicy_sg.body: Singapore's top court released its full judgment detailing why former Wah!Banana content creator Lev Panfilov was acquitted of rape. The ruling provides the exhaustive evidentiary findings behind overturning his conviction.

juicy_sg.headline: NUS Vice Provost and Environmental Policy Scholar Leong Ching Dies at 57
juicy_sg.body: National University of Singapore Vice Provost Leong Ching has passed away at the age of 57. She was widely recognised across academia for her scholarship in water governance and public policy.

juicy_sg.headline: Brother Handed Life Sentence for Chaining and Starving Sister to Death
juicy_sg.body: A 34-year-old man was sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of his 19-year-old sister after keeping her chained and malnourished inside a toilet. The presiding judge strongly condemned the prolonged domestic cruelty.

juicy_sg.headline: MOM Identifies 147 Roles in 2027 Critical Shortage List
juicy_sg.body: The Ministry of Manpower published its 2027 Shortage Occupation List identifying 147 key job titles across seven sectors including semiconductors, tech, and healthcare. The framework sets the benchmark for targeted foreign specialist hiring.
